## Summary

Adds the exact helper-donor kernel borrow43 (PR2226 anticipatory dirty borrowing of Cinna Davis (1337isnot1337), adapted to the T74 words) to the previous record's T74 local words (re-solved frames, fresh natives, PLAN rebound, SPEC refrozen) under the PR1673 capped phase-cell fusion outer; re-solves the frames of the borrowed gauge44 word exactly (WildIdeas); and, new in this package, applies the exact helper-donor pivot kernel(s) 518 and 506 (the PR1625 mdumitrean shape; search and exact pricing by KernelsOnBorrow) to both borrowed words with all frames re-solved (local profile {1:2341, 2:505, 3:420, 4:125, 5:42, 8:8} plus 8 width-8 helpers, mass 5385 unchanged; audited forward and dual by new/borrow/audit_local.py, with tamper controls on the kernel reads; native chains, rebind, discovery and the strict assembly rerun). The supplier native and conservative complex endpoints are certified to 1e-3000 (accept at the endpoint, reject at endpoint + 1e-3000), grid_digits 2995, margin_digits 3005, bootstrap_steps 1116, and the PR1956 carried bootstrap cutoffs and PR1964 Lemma G label stage are retained. Conditional final kappa = 0.0016963957667360813401512017553615279117…(3046 digits) (supplier strict-assembly kappa 0.0016935228816887139163412051031782853465…(2995 digits)). Retuned to the fixed-grid maximum of PR2180 / PR2161 (dataisfire): kappa = C - 1/F - B exactly (floor grid 1e-3046, backoff 1e-3022, C the certified endpoint; outer/PROOF-GRID-MAX.md). It exceeds PR2288 (the same package without the kernel) and PR2269 by 8.48163E-8, PR2265 by 1.29832E-5 (63 strict inequalities: the 62 retained ones plus the explicit main-binding row gaussian_above_main, 17 rejecting controls). The single 3000-digit rejection moment of the strict assembly uses PR2168's exact-integer coarse exponential (code/exact_coarse.py, EXACT-ARITHMETIC-DERIVATION.json; intervals identical to the retained engine).
